evidence.quote: As an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
FARXIGA is not recommended for use to improve glycemic control in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)].

response.reasoning: The label indicates FARXIGA is an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control only in adults and pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes, and explicitly states it is not recommended for use to improve glycemic control in patients with type 1 diabetes. The claim asserts improvement in type 1 diabetes, which conflicts with the label.
